B18.visual_intent: A block of 32 ink check marks draws in; 'guarantee' sits over a hero 0; a 'world' circle sends three dim arrows up under the checks, then the arrows drop away and a terracotta dot is left in the circle.
B18.motion_claim: Checks pile up while guarantee stays 0; the world's support quietly vanishes.
B18.why: The claim is an asymmetry (count rises, guarantee does not): two things moving or not moving beside each other; a card would show one number only.

B19.visual_intent: Turkey drawn from circles/arcs; a day counter runs 1 to 1,000; a schematic confidence curve rises with a dot riding it; counter ticks to 1,001, an axe lands and the curve drops vertically to the axis. Caption 'schematic'.
B19.motion_claim: Confidence rises with every day; then the line falls off a cliff.
B19.why: The curve's drop is the claim; a counter alone cannot show confidence outrunning evidence.

B20.visual_intent: Scatter of ink dots on a model line (correlation); a dashed hidden block 'mechanism' with a lever appears; the lever flips, the block turns solid, the dots fall off the line while the line stays; a turkey returns at the end.
B20.motion_claim: The mechanism flips and the line does not notice.
B20.why: One scene, one cause: the lever flip and the dots leaving the unchanged line happen at the same moment the voice says it.

B21.visual_intent: Two grey bars: $304.4M (Q3 write-down) and $240-265M (expected Q4 charges, dashed top for the range); four outline tiles with one crossed out for 25% of staff. Caption per Zillow 8-K, Nov 2021.
B21.motion_claim: Bars grow as each figure is spoken; one of four tiles is struck.
B21.why: Two amounts compared to scale read faster as bars than as two numerals; the staff share is a quarter-fill.

B22.visual_intent: 108 outlined week tiles (18 x 6) draw in, then 100 fill grey while 8 stay empty; hero '100 of 108 weeks too high'; the real quote 'big data hubris' with the Lazer et al., Science, 2014 caption. Tile order marked schematic.
B22.motion_claim: Tiles fill until almost every week is a miss.
B22.why: The proportion (100 of 108) is the evidence; filling a grid makes the proportion visible.

B23.visual_intent: Circle 'model' with a terracotta confidence dot; circle 'world'; a solid arrow model-to-world, a dashed arrow back crossed out; a ripple ring around the world; a bracket with a check mark labelled 'supervisor' joins them.
B23.motion_claim: The arrow runs one way; the world changes and nothing comes back; only the bracket check connects them.
B23.why: A drawn missing return signal is the claim.

B24.visual_intent: Claim card 'performs well' beside a dashed twin 'performs badly?'; three outline slots (metric, threshold, window) fill with drawn glyphs: bars, a curve against a line, a bracketed time axis, while a terracotta dot walks along.
B24.motion_claim: Three blanks get filled one after another on the three spoken questions.
B24.why: Glyphs show what each blank means without extra words; a form card would be three empty text fields.

B25.visual_intent: Eight white swans (ellipse, bezier neck, circle head, triangle beak) accumulate under 'all swans are white'; one black swan grows large, is ringed, the whites ghost out; 'break it'.
B25.motion_claim: Whites pile up, one black ends the count.
B25.why: Colour is the whole claim, and the swan asymmetry needs the swans.

B26.visual_intent: Two columns: internal validation (six white swans, three checks) and external test (dashed circle with '?' becomes a black swan); 'unrefuted != validated' lands at the bottom.
B26.motion_claim: The empty external slot fills with the black swan.
B26.why: Reuses B25's cast: counted whites against one attempted black.

B27.visual_intent: Two-row table: 'vague / robust' and 'specific / error rate < 2% over 30 days', each with five outcome circles; the vague row gets five checks, the specific row three checks and two crosses with a terracotta dot beside a failure; tag 'illustrative thresholds'.
B27.motion_claim: Same five outcomes: all pass the vague claim; the specific one fails two.
B27.why: Rows of outcomes make 'fits any outcome' and 'names its failure' visible at once.
